description_en: Lists administrators of a specified knowledge base with pagination
description_zh: 分页查询指定知识库的管理员
name: ListKnowledgeBaseAdministrators

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，省略默认20，范围1至100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The cursor returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标，首次不传
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

KnowledgeBaseAdministrators.description_en: The administrators on the current page, excluding the owner
KnowledgeBaseAdministrators.description_zh: 本页管理员，不包含 Owner

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the record, represented as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 该记录的创建时间，以毫秒级 Unix 时间戳表示

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the user. This field is optional and is not used to verify the user’s identity
DisplayName.description_zh: 用户展示名称，可选；不作为身份依据

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The ID of the knowledge base

UserId.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the administrator

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page used for the current request. If the input parameter is omitted, the value is 20. This is not the actual number of entries returned on the current page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求采用的每页条数上限；省略入参时为 20，不是本页实际返回条数

NextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. If no subsequent pages exist, null is returned
NextToken.description_zh: 后续页游标；无后续页返回 null

Message.description_en: The security error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
